name: context-vault
description: Store, search, update, and forget chat-scoped user context with immediate lexical recall, background semantic warmup, hybrid multilingual ranking when ready, and prior Pi session fallback.

MAX_RESULTS.prompt: Maximum number of context results to return.

SEMANTIC_CANDIDATES.prompt: Minimum number of semantic candidates considered before hybrid reranking.

MIN_SIMILARITY.prompt: Minimum semantic similarity accepted during memory recall.

MODEL.prompt: Local Hugging Face embedding model used by SeekMix.

DTYPE.prompt: Local embedding model data type, for example q8.

IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.prompt: How long the chat-scoped semantic memory daemon stays warm while idle.
